FUJIFILM INSTAX mini 11 Instant Film Camera

The FUJIFILM INSTAX mini 11 Instant Film Camera is designed to provide instant pictures with high-quality prints, using the FUJIFILM Instax mini instant film to produce photo pictures sized at 62 mm × 46 mm. The lens on the Polaroid camera has two components and two elements, with a 1:12.7 aperture and a focal length of 60 mm. Accurate framing is guaranteed by its actual image finder, which has a target point and 0.37× magnification. The Instant camera's 0.3-meter shooting range makes it perfect for close-up photos when in selfie mode, which is designed for distances of 0.3 to 0.5 meters. With a slow synchro mode for low light and a preset electronic shutter that operates between 1/2 and 1/250 seconds, the camera produces bright, clear images under a variety of lighting circumstances. With automatic exposure management, the ISO of 800 is equivalent to light intensities between Lv 5.0 and 14.5. The film is automatically ejected by the FUJIFILM INSTAX mini 11 Instant Camera, and it takes about 90 seconds to develop, though this can change based on the outside temperature. With new AA-size alkaline batteries, the INSTAX mini 11 Polaroid Instant Camera has a flash recycle time of 6.5 seconds or less and is equipped with a continuous firing flash that adapts automatically to lighting situations. With an effective flash range of 0.3 to 2.7 meters, you can take well-lit pictures even in low light. Two AA-sized alkaline batteries are required to operate the FUJIFILM INSTAX mini 11 Instant Camera, which is capable of holding around ten Instax mini film packs with ten exposures each. Other features include a convenient film pack confirmation display, a film counter, and an auto power-off mode that shuts off after five minutes to preserve battery life. The INSTAX mini 11 is a great option for effortlessly and stylishly capturing impromptu moments because it is small and easy to use.

products.name: FUJIFILM Instax Mini EVO Hybrid Instant Camera
products.description:
FUJIFILM Instax Mini EVO Hybrid Instant Film Camera

The FUJIFILM Instax Mini EVO Hybrid Instant Camera features a 1/5-inch CMOS image sensor with a primary color filter, capturing images at a resolution of 2560 x 1920 pixels. This FUJIFILM Instax Mini EVO Instant Camera offers versatile storage options, with internal memory holding about 45 images and a microSD/microSDHC memory card storing up to 850 images. It records images in DCF-compliant Exif Ver 2.3 format. With an f = 28 mm focus distance (35-mm film equivalent) and an F2.0 aperture, the FUJIFILM Instax Mini EVO Camera delivers excellent clarity. The camera uses a single autofocus with an AF illuminator, and the shooting distance ranges from 10 cm to infinity. It offers a wide shutter speed range from 1/4 second to 1/8000 second and shooting sensitivity from ISO 100 to 1600, both of which adjust automatically. The FUJIFILM Instax Mini EVO Instant Film Camera features Program AE for exposure control, and exposure compensation from −2.0 EV to +2.0 EV in 1/3 EV steps. The FUJIFILM Instax Mini EVO Film Camera supports TTL 256 split metering and multi-metering, with multiple white balance settings, including Auto, Fine, Shade, and Fluorescent. Flash modes include Auto, Forced, and Suppressed, with a shooting range of 50 cm to 1.5 m. The self-timer offers 2 seconds or 10 seconds, and 100 creative effects are available, combining 10 lens effects and 10 film effects. For printing, the FUJIFILM Instant Camera has an exposure print pixel count of 1600 x 600 dots, with a resolution of 25 dots/mm by 12.5 dots/mm, and prints JPEG images from internal memory or memory cards. It has a 3.0-inch TFT color LCD screen with approximately 460,000 dots. Powered by a lithium-ion battery, the camera can print about 100 images per full charge, with a charging time of 2 to 3 hours. Measuring 87 mm x 122.9 mm x 36 mm and weighing 285 g, the FUJIFILM Instax Mini EVO Instant Camera operates in temperatures from 5°C to 40°C and humidity levels from 20% to 80%. The camera uses FUJIFILM Instax Mini film, sold separately, for instant photography.
